en.headline: Trial booking system opens for High Island Reservoir’s Po Toi Chau section
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department has set a daily quota of 2,000 visitors for selected weekends and holidays from 5 September, with online real-name registration via Klook.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department began accepting bookings on 24 August for a trial appointment system covering the Po Toi Chau section of the High Island Reservoir East Dam geological trail. The system applies to selected weekends, the Mid-Autumn Festival period and the National Day Golden Week from 5 September to 7 October.

A daily quota of 2,000 places is divided into four two-hour time slots of 500 each. Visitors must register with real names through the designated platform; each booking covers up to five people. Assistant Director To Man-wai said the trial aims to protect the trail, improve visitor experience and test carrying capacity, drawing on past Golden Week numbers and typical visit lengths of about two hours for the two-kilometre round trip.

As of the evening of 24 August about 10 per cent of the first available slots had been taken, mainly for morning periods. Same-day online bookings remain possible if places are left, and on-site staff will assist. Cancellations can be made 48 hours in advance; the department is monitoring no-show rates before considering any future penalty or fee.

zh.headline: 萬宜水庫破邊洲段試行預約制 每日限額二千
zh.dek: 漁護署已開放9月5日起指定周末及假期名額，須經指定平台實名登記，每日合共二千個名額分四個時段。
body: 漁農自然護理署於8月24日開始接受西貢萬宜水庫東壩破邊洲段地質步道的試行預約申請。制度適用於9月5日至10月7日期間的指定周末、中秋及國慶黃金周。
每日名額二千人，分為四個兩小時時段，每個時段五百人。訪客須經指定平台以實名制登記，每次最多五人。助理署長陶文慧表示，試行旨在保護山徑、提升遊客體驗及測試承載量，參考過往黃金周人流及來回約兩公里山徑一般需時兩小時等因素。
截至24日傍晚，首批名額暫約一成已預約，主要集中早上時段。若當天仍有餘額可即時網上預約，現場亦設職員協助。市民可於48小時前取消預約；署方會觀察缺席情況，再考慮日後是否引入懲罰或收費機制。
